notes.title: Patch Notes - March 23rd, 2025
notes.content:
There has been feedback from new players that the movement doesn't feel good or is too challenging. The game is meant to be challenging but most players will give up before making it over that "hump" where they have a good feel for the controls and I don't blame them.

I've increased the swing force when swinging left and right as well as the speed to length or shorten your tongue. This should make it easier for new players to get back into the swinging action with less frustration of slowly building momentum over and over after making a mistake.

Buffs:
- Swing Force: 150 --> 200
- Tongue Length Speed: 2 --> 3

Other changes:
- able to jump while moving up ramps
- added a cursor outline
- fixed a bug where resetting during the tutorial would also reset the main game splits
